description: Spec Board: build a tech-pack style spec board from a garment photo. Give garment_type, or use Reference mode: a reference_image (an existing spec board) whose layout and sections are mimicked. Best for: turning a garment photo (saree, kurti, suit, lehenga, frock or gown) into a professional specification board for production. Result files are saved to disk and their paths returned.

estimate_only.description: Only return the credit estimate; nothing is uploaded or charged.

garment_type.description: Garment type: saree (Saree), kurti (Kurti), suit (Suit), lehenga (Lehenga), frock (Frock), gown (Gown), dupatta (Dupatta), all_over (All-over), shirt_tshirt (Shirt/T-shirt), western (Western). Required: pass the mode the user named. If the user did not name one, omit it and the tool returns the modes to show them; never choose for the user. Required unless reference_image is given; there is no default garment. Call describe_tool for what each option does.

image.description: Source image: a local file path or an http(s) URL. PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 80 MB and 5000 px per side.

output_dir.description: Folder to save results in. Default: the folder of the input image (or the current directory for URL inputs). Files are never overwritten.

reference_image.description: Reference mode: a reference spec board (path or URL). When given, the output mimics its sections, layout and styling and garment_type is not used.

review_settings.description: Omit it and the tool first asks whether to use the recommended settings or adjust them (unless the call already sets some). true: ask each setting one by one. false: run with the given or recommended settings without asking; pass it only after the user chose that.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the job before returning its task_id (default 240).

unlimited_bundle.description: Request the Unlimited bundle for this run (only has effect on Unlimited plans; the server decides).

wait.description: Wait for the job and save the outputs (default true). false returns the task_id right after submit.

name: td_spec_board
title: Spec Board
